item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00064","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C15","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C10 is the direct and material drafting template. The child expressly identifies the January 30 proclamation as an earlier supplement to the same December 16, 1947 and January 1, 1948 trade proclamations, repeats its statutory and trade-agreement recitals, and uses the same machinery of determinations followed by deletions, modifications, and additions to specifically numbered tariff items and recitals. Indeed, the child further amends provisions that C10 itself added or changed. C15 is also materially incorporated as the underlying Cuba proclamation, but C10 is the stronger and more immediate template. C03 shares only generic proclamation form and an enumerated list.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Whereas, on December 16, 1947, by proclamation 2761A the President proclaimed such modifications of existing duties and other import restrictions ... which proclamation has been supplemented by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of January 30, 1948","parent_excerpt":"Whereas, on December 16, 1947 by Proclamation 2761A the President proclaimed such modifications of existing duties and other import restrictions ...","explanation":"Both instruments supplement the same foundational trade proclamation, and the child explicitly identifies C10 as the intervening supplement."},{"child_excerpt":"Whereas, I determine that ... the deletion of the second item 1527(c) (2) from the list set forth in the 7th recital of said proclamation of January 30, 1948 is required or appropriate to carry out ... said trade agreement","parent_excerpt":"Whereas, I determine that the application of such of the concessions provided for in part I of schedule XX ... as are identified in the following list is required or appropriate to carry out said trade agreement","explanation":"The child closely reuses C10's determination formula and directly amends a tariff item in C10's recital."},{"child_excerpt":"the deletion of the second item 1527(c)(2), added to said 8th recital by subdivision (a) of part II of said proclamation of January 30, 1948","parent_excerpt":"PART II ... (a) That the rates of duty specified ... shall be applied ... to products of the republic of Cuba ... as if said products had been listed in said 8th recital","explanation":"The child's operative amendment targets the precise recital and Part II mechanism established by C10."},{"child_excerpt":"To the end that said trade agreement specified in the 3rd recital of this proclamation may be carried out, I do further proclaim that ... the lists set forth in the 8th and 9th recitals ... shall be further amended","parent_excerpt":"I DO further proclaim, acting under the authority of said section 350 to the end that said exclusive trade agreement specified in the 3rd recital of this proclamation may be carried out","explanation":"This is distinctive shared operative language organizing amendments to the same Cuba trade-agreement schedules under the same statutory authority."}]}
